module.name: vitest-context-expect
module.description: Identifies a local expect value destructured from a Vitest test callback context.

scenarios.name: should resolve destructured expect aliases from Vitest test callbacks
scenarios.given: a Vitest test or it callback destructures expect with an optional local alias
scenarios.when: isVitestContextExpect resolves the callback parameter binding

scenarios.name: should resolve computed expect property names
scenarios.given: a Vitest test callback destructures the static computed expect key

scenarios.name: should reject unrelated destructured parameters
scenarios.given: a function with a destructured expect parameter is not a Vitest test callback

scenarios.name: should reject shadowed or unrelated test bindings
scenarios.given: test is locally shadowed or imported from another package
